answer:
The U-values (\\(\text{W/m}^2\text{K}\\)) for existing Swiss residential buildings by construction period and element, as well as target reference values, are documented in the uploaded source **"Research report: Swiss Building Standards & Heat Pump Benchmarks"**.

---

### 1. As-Built Typology U-Values by Construction Era

**Source:** *Research report: Swiss Building Standards & Heat Pump Benchmarks*  
**Section:** Section 2, *TABULA / EPISCOPE Swiss Building Typology U-Values (\\(E_{\text{as\_built}}\\))* [1]

* **Before 1975 (< 1975: Pre-energy crisis)** [1]
  * **Wall U-value:** \\(1.0 - 1.4\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Roof U-value:** \\(0.8 - 1.0\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Window U-value:** \\(2.8 - 3.0\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) (Single/Glazed) [1]
  * **Floor U-value:** \\(0.9 - 1.2\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Overall Mean Envelope \\(U_{\text{as\_built}}\\):** \\(\mathbf{1.20 - 1.50\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}}\\) [1]

* **1976 – 1990 (1st Thermal Insulation Regulations)** [1]
  * **Wall U-value:** \\(0.50 - 0.63\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Roof U-value:** \\(0.28 - 0.40\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Window U-value:** \\(2.3 - 2.5\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) (Double) [1]
  * **Floor U-value:** \\(0.6 - 0.8\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Overall Mean Envelope \\(U_{\text{as\_built}}\\):** \\(\mathbf{0.70 - 0.90\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}}\\) [1]

* **1991 – 2000 (Enhanced Insulation)** [1]
  * **Wall U-value:** \\(0.35 - 0.45\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Roof U-value:** \\(0.20 - 0.28\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Window U-value:** \\(1.5 - 1.8\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Floor U-value:** \\(0.4 - 0.5\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Overall Mean Envelope \\(U_{\text{as\_built}}\\):** \\(\mathbf{0.50 - 0.60\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}}\\) [1]

* **2001 – 2010 (MoPEC 2000 / Minergie)** [1]
  * **Wall U-value:** \\(0.22 - 0.28\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Roof U-value:** \\(0.15 - 0.20\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Window U-value:** \\(1.2 - 1.3\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Floor U-value:** \\(0.25 - 0.35\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Overall Mean Envelope \\(U_{\text{as\_built}}\\):** \\(\mathbf{0.35 - 0.45\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}}\\) [1]

* **After 2010 (> 2010: MoPEC 2014 / NZEB)** [1]
  * **Wall U-value:** \\(0.15 - 0.18\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Roof U-value:** \\(0.10 - 0.15\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Window U-value:** \\(0.8 - 1.0\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) (Triple) [1]
  * **Floor U-value:** \\(0.18 - 0.22\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [1]
  * **Overall Mean Envelope \\(U_{\text{as\_built}}\\):** \\(\mathbf{0.20 - 0.28\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}}\\) [1]

---

### 2. Standard Reference Target U-Values (\\(U_{\text{limit}}\\))

**Source:** *Research report: Swiss Building Standards & Heat Pump Benchmarks*  
**Section:** Section 3, *SIA 380/1 & SIA 2024: Target Values & Standard Usage Data (\\(E_{\text{reference}}\\))* [2]

* **Façade / Exterior Wall:** \\(0.20\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [2]
* **Roof / Attic Floor:** \\(0.15\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [2]
* **Floor against ground/unheated:** \\(0.20\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [2]
* **Windows:** \\(1.00\text{ W/m}^2\text{K}\\) [2]

*(Note: Direct U-value tables for non-Swiss regions like Germany or Central Europe are not in the uploaded sources beyond these TABULA Swiss typology benchmarks).*
